name: Shinohana
source:
A quiet mountain village. A boy is found fallen in the waterfall and a girl is found fallen from a mountain there. Both have lost memory. Can village songs and mysterious flowers growing there be keys to their memory?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个安静的山村。一名男孩被发现坠入瀑布，一名女孩被发现从山上坠落。两人都失去了记忆。乡村歌曲和那里生长的神秘花朵能否成为他们记忆的钥匙？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
